name: Dhania
kitchenUse: A teaspoon of seeds soaked overnight in a glass of water, strained and sipped in the morning; fresh leaves on food.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Food amounts; 1–2 teaspoons of seeds a day as seed water
typicalUse.note: Texts differ on its potency (virya): the seed is often called cooling, so the field is left empty until review.

cautions.note: Coriander can cause allergic reactions, including in people allergic to related plants such as celery or fennel.

evidence.summary: Mostly laboratory and animal studies on digestion and blood sugar; little research in people.
